entries.name: PR review checklist
entries.description: Talentech PR review checklist. Cover these points on every review: correctness, tests, security, observability, accessibility. Supersedes ad-hoc reviewer lists.

entries.name: PR description template
entries.description: Canonical PR description template: summary, motivation, change list, test plan, rollback. Use for every PR; agents should fill as many sections as possible automatically.

entries.name: Python style guide
entries.description: Talentech Python conventions: formatting, typing, imports, error handling, logging. Supersedes PEP 8 where they conflict.

entries.name: TypeScript style guide
entries.description: Talentech TypeScript conventions: strict mode, module layout, error handling, async patterns. Supersedes community defaults where explicit.

entries.name: React component patterns
entries.description: Component patterns for React at Talentech: composition over inheritance, hooks vs context, when to split, styling conventions.

entries.name: Git commit message convention
entries.description: How Talentech writes commit messages: imperative mood, body explains why not what, link issues/work items. Use for every commit.

entries.name: Git branch naming convention
entries.description: Branch naming convention at Talentech: type/short-slug, linked to work items.

entries.name: Secrets handling
entries.description: How to handle credentials, tokens, and keys at Talentech: never commit, use managed identity first, rotate on exposure. Supersedes per-repo secrets docs.

entries.name: Dependency policy
entries.description: Policy for adding and updating third-party dependencies: approval, scanning, pinning, SBOM. Source: Talentech Group → GT space → Dependency Management.

entries.name: Unit testing conventions
entries.description: How to write unit tests at Talentech: naming, structure, mocking, coverage expectations.

entries.name: Integration testing conventions
entries.description: Integration testing rules: real services where feasible, mocks at trust boundaries only.

entries.name: Azure DevOps work-item conventions
entries.description: How to write ADO work items: title format, description structure, linking, tagging.

entries.name: WCAG accessibility baseline
entries.description: Minimum accessibility requirements for Talentech UIs: WCAG 2.1 AA. Checklist for components and pages.

entries.name: GDPR / PII handling
entries.description: How to handle candidate and customer PII under GDPR at Talentech: collection, processing, retention, erasure. Required reading for any feature touching user data.

entries.name: Incident response runbook
entries.description: Declaring, managing, and resolving incidents at Talentech: severity levels, comms, roles.

entries.name: Production deploy runbook
entries.description: How to deploy to production safely: change windows, canary, rollback.

entries.name: Rotate secrets runbook
entries.description: Step-by-step rotation of shared secrets when a leak is suspected.

entries.name: PRD template
entries.description: Canonical PRD skeleton at Talentech. Used by the write_prd prompt.

entries.description: Canonical RFC skeleton.

entries.description: Canonical ADR skeleton.
